title: TP53 promotes lineage commitment of human embryonic stem cells through ciliogenesis and sonic hedgehog signaling
model: Human ESC->NPC differentiation, GeCKO v2 library
paper_calls: SOX1, ciliary genes (IFT140, OFD1), Shh negative regulators
barcs_calls: 4,417 genes at FDR 0.10; top class = ciliogenesis/Shh repressors
verdict: BARCS ranks SOX1 and the ciliary genes IFT140/OFD1 in the top 12 and its top enriched genes (SUFU, OFD1, SOX1, IFT140, GLI3) match the ciliogenesis/Shh-repressor classes the paper highlights.
